description: BUTYLHYOSCINE 10 MG 12 TABLETS BUSCAPINA Butylhyoscine, known by the brand name Buscopina, is an antispasmodic medication that relieves abdominal pain caused by gastrointestinal cramps. The 10 mg hyoscine butylbromide tablets work by relaxing the muscles of the digestive and genitourinary tracts. Use and effect Pain relief: Butylhyoscine is indicated for the relief of colic, abdominal cramps, and discomfort. It acts quickly: Its effect begins to be felt in about 15 minutes, acting directly at the source of the pain. Mechanism of action: The active ingredient, hyoscine butylbromide, interferes with the function of acetylcholine, a neurotransmitter that causes the contraction of smooth muscles, resulting in a relaxing effect. Buscopan Varieties There are different presentations of Buscopan to suit various needs, although the 10 mg butylscopolamine version is the most basic for abdominal pain. Buscopan Duo: Contains butylscopolamine and paracetamol, offering a dual antispasmodic and analgesic action for faster and more effective relief of stomach pain and cramps. Buscopan Fem: Formulated to relieve menstrual cramps, it contains a combination of butylscopolamine and ibuprofen. Availability in Pharmacies You can find Buscopan 10 mg in a 12-tablet presentation at various pharmacies, both physical and online, in Mexico. Some options include: Farmacias Similares: Offers the 12-tablet presentation. BuscaMed: Sells the 12-tablet box of Buscopan 10 mg. Farmacias GeneriQ: Also carries the 12-tablet box. Farmapronto: They have Buscapina 10 mg tablets for sale in packs of 12. Other retailers: You can also find it at other establishments such as Farmacias San Pablo and Soriana. Considerations Warning: It is important to consult a healthcare professional before taking any medication. Alternative presentations: Keep in mind that some pharmacies may offer a 24-tablet presentation or combination versions such as Buscapina Duo or Buscapina Fem.
